why_best: This organic pacing mirrors the authentic rhythm of an engineer at work, making the product feel grounded, functional, and instantly recognizable to technical decision-makers.
why_bad: Slapping static blocks of text onto the screen all at once destroys the sense of active progress and leaves the scene feeling like a flat presentation slide rather than a live system.
trap: A weak attempt will make the character reveal feel like a mechanical robotic stream instead of mimicking human thought and keystroke cadence.
